expectations.text: Does not deliver sponsor-page copy as the first or main deliverable; places funding last in the move order and states that money reduces neither inflow nor the backlog.

expectations.evidence: 'Capacity = 3h × 60 × ½ on tracker ÷ 15 min = 6 first replies/week, about 25/month.'

expectations.text: States that 45 new issues a month exceeds about four weeks of replies, so intake is cut before any window is published.
